solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**The misspelled word is 'Alterior'.**

__
 
• **The correct spelling would be 'Ulterior'.**
 
• The word '**ulterior**' is an **adjective** which means 'existing beyond what is obvious or admitted; intentionally hidden'. **(गुप्त या छुपा हुआ)**
 
 
• **For Example -** 
 
• She had ulterior motives for helping him.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer would be** 'Alterior'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Let's understand the meanings of the other marked words - **

 
• **Ephemeral -** things that exist or are used or enjoyed for only a short time **(क्षणभंगुर चीजें)**
 
• **Preposterous - **contrary to reason or common sense; utterly absurd or ridiculous **(हास्यास्पद)**
 
• **Paraphernalia -** miscellaneous articles, especially the equipment needed for a particular activity **(सामान)**
